    How it works

    Four Steps.
    No Waiting.

    1. 01Step 1

      Mint A Broker

      Pay the mint price in SOL. You get one of 4,444 brokers.

    2. 02Step 2

      Instant Reveal

      Seconds later, a block produced after your mint draws its tier from the stock still left.

    3. 03Step 3

      Clock In

      Pay the seat price in SOL. It buys $MetBroker on the pool and burns it. Your broker is frozen while it works.

    4. 04Step 4

      Claim MET

      Earnings accrue every second by weight. Claim whenever you like, or clock out to sell.

        Floor rules

        Written Into
        The Program.

        Nobody, including the team, can change these after launch.

        Rule 01

        Fees Stream, They Don't Drop

        Every MET that reaches the vault is released over seven days. A launch-day spike is shared with everyone who joins that week.

        Rule 02

        Earn From Your Clock-In

        Each seat checkpoints the reward counter when it starts. No back pay, no snapshot to time.

        Rule 03

        Claim Any Time

        Earnings accrue every second and can be claimed whenever you like.

        Rule 04

        Same SOL For Everyone

        Seat price is fixed in SOL per weight, so being early buys no discount. That SOL buys $MetBroker and burns it.

        Rule 05

        Working Brokers Are Frozen

        To sell or move one, clock out first. A new owner clocks in again and pays again.

        Rule 06

        Drawn, Not Picked

        Your tier comes from a block produced after you paid, out of what is left, so nobody can pick a rare broker or undo a common one.

        Rule 07

        An Empty Floor Pauses

        If nobody is clocked in, nothing is released. The first seat back does not inherit a backlog.

        Fee flow

        The Creator Side Goes To Brokers

        Every $MetBroker trade pays a fee. After Meteora's protocol share and the platform share, the whole creator side streams to brokers, on the curve and after migration. How fees flow
